source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
From ESM, go to Site Inspection > Job Type "ADA (Accessibility)
3. Scroll until you find the site where you did the inspection and download the PDF.
4. Open the PDF and see the comments.

* From there, look at the picture and find the reason why the building didn't pass inspection. 
* You want to look at the image that was recorded and what was the cause of that discrepancy. Sometimes it's just the location not being accessible, sometimes it's missing a certain item.

5. Go and look physically at the location on the map.
6. Go to: http://www.google.com/maps/?ll= , then put the coordinates of the building in the search bar.

* Don't trust the highlighted area, always zoom in.
* Copy the coordinates from the records to the search bar.
* Hit enter.

7. Find the location
